name: 1970s earth tones

influenced_by: the 1973 oil crisis's effect on consumer optimism
a renewed interest in craft/natural materials

garments: harvest gold and avocado green appliances
reacts_against: the previous decade's bright psychedelic and Space Age optimism, settling into a warmer, earthier, more domestic palette as the economic mood cooled.
revivals: a frequent interior-design nostalgia reference since the 2010s

findings: mostly muted — about 88% of the measured color is low-saturation (greys, dusty tones)
measured.caveat: Colors measured from Wikimedia Commons images as photographed and displayed on screen; actual materials vary, and screen colors are approximate.
